speech_title: Full interview with WIS News 10 on Senate priorities
main_topics: Public option; preventive care; health-system cost
major_quotes: I know as a pediatrician that prevention is actually a cost-effective approach to building a health care system. So the more folks who have access to primary care doctors for early diagnosis and treatment of diseases, the less our entire health care system is going to cost. My plan includes a public option, and a public option doesn't mean the government is paying for someone's health care. A public option means that you or I have the option to purchase an affordable public plan if we choose.
rhetorical_devices: Professional-identity warrant ('I know as a pediatrician'); comparative construction ('the more... the less'); anticipatory refutation ('a public option doesn't mean...'); definition by contrast
personal_story_elements: Pediatric practice as the basis of the argument
policy_claims: Public option (voluntary purchase, not single-payer); prevention and primary care; system cost reduction
